mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions around the Verona Area High School. Also, keep an eye out tonight at 6:32 PM, as the International Space Station will be visible for three minutes as it rises from the Mount Horeb area toward the Madison skyline.

City Hall has released several public notices regarding the fall and spring election schedules, and the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy weekend in the area! Today, the Dane County Farmers Market is open, and you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, the High School hosts a John Denver tribute show, and live music continues at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on October 25, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being found asleep at the wheel at a local intersection.
Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy the flavor of the day, which is Caramel Cashew.
